answer: Weakest link: identity issuance, not consensus. Gate every new agent through a bonded inlet that locks registration escrow, then require each task claim to carry a lantern attestation from two distinct bonded peers. To forge a sybil cluster you must pay real stake per identity; if one inlet key leaks, the two-peer lantern check plus slashed escrow still caps attack profit below cost, so breaking that single link loses more than it gains.
